source.h_model_method: rest pose, the body mesh skinned at rest by the runtime importer: crown (max up) minus sole (min up), metres (every 7th vertex; sole 0.0025, crown 1.7271)

camera.frame: port model: x screen-right, y toward camera, z up; origin = character ground origin
camera.character_heading: theta = 90 - bearing about +Y (the model faces +Z); frame-0 root forward measured per cell

image.lights_detail: the Barrow's winter sun (paint_stack.gd: 55 deg, screen azimuth 305, (1.0, 0.955, 0.885), energy 0.90, shadow blur 1.7) as a child of the camera, ambient 0.30 white; self-shadowing only (no ground)

idle.closure_mad_note: max over the 8 directions of mean |RGBA(T) - RGBA(0)| over the FIGURE's pixels (either frame opaque), 0-255; render(T) is rendered for this and is not in the pack

walk.stride_method: the clip is in place at source; stride = the manifest's FOOT-LOCK speed (1.400 m/s, the speed that holds the planted foot still) x the clip length (0.8000 s)
walk.closure_mad_note: max over the 8 directions of mean |RGBA(T) - RGBA(0)| over the FIGURE's pixels (either frame opaque), 0-255; render(T) is rendered for this and is not in the pack

run.stride_method: the clip is in place at source; stride = the manifest's FOOT-LOCK speed (3.210 m/s, the speed that holds the planted foot still) x the clip length (0.5000 s)
run.closure_mad_note: max over the 8 directions of mean |RGBA(T) - RGBA(0)| over the FIGURE's pixels (either frame opaque), 0-255; render(T) is rendered for this and is not in the pack

attack_slam.skill: the roster's claw slam (melee 0-3.09 m); release = both claws striking the ground

attack_strike.skill: the roster's spout strike / shell spin (melee); release = the left claw's stab

cast_breath.skill: the roster's freezing breath (aoe wave 3.5 m x 1 m, cold)

cast_lob.skill: the roster's lobbed spout (projectile, area r 3 m)

sockets_def.mouth: the mouth plates under the shell's front edge (shell bone rear->front 0.70 m, +0.20 m beyond, 0.12 m down)
sockets_def.claw_L_tip: the LEFT pincer tip (wrist -> tip, measured)
sockets_def.head_top: the top of the shell (HUD anchor)

alpha_union_bbox_convention: [x0, y0, x1, y1), x1/y1 exclusive -- PIL getchannel('A').getbbox(), as stage_art.py crops
